name: Google and AOSP
note: Packages found on nearly every Android phone regardless of brand. Disabling a Google app does not sign you out of your account; it stops that one app.

packages.label: Google Photos
packages.note: Cloud photo backup. Your OEM gallery still shows every photo. Backups stop until re-enabled.

packages.label: YouTube
packages.note: The website works in any browser.

packages.label: YouTube Music
packages.note: Preinstalled on most phones and set as the default music handler. Install something else first if you play local files.

packages.label: Google Drive
packages.note: Other apps that 'save to Drive' lose that option.

packages.label: Google Maps
packages.note: Navigation apps and 'open in maps' links from other apps stop working unless you install an alternative.

packages.label: Digital Wellbeing
packages.note: Screen-time tracking. Also removes parental-control timers if anyone relies on them.

packages.label: Device Health Services
packages.note: Feeds adaptive battery. Some phones show worse battery estimates afterwards.

packages.label: Google Contacts Sync
packages.note: Contacts stop syncing to your account. People lose their address book after a factory reset.

packages.label: Google Assistant
packages.note: Also kills voice commands on paired headphones and in the car.

packages.label: Google app / search bar
packages.note: The stock Pixel and many OEM launchers embed this search bar and can crash on the home screen without it. Install another launcher first.

packages.label: Data Restore Tool
packages.note: Only used when setting up a new phone.

packages.label: Android Auto
packages.note: Disable only if you never connect the phone to a car.

packages.label: Health Connect
packages.note: Fitness apps that share data through it stop syncing with each other.

packages.label: Personal Safety
packages.note: Car-crash detection and emergency SOS live here. Leave it on for an elderly user.

packages.label: Google Calendar
packages.note: Calendar sync continues, but nothing displays it until you install another calendar.

packages.label: Gmail
packages.note: Mail stops arriving. Obvious, and still the most common regret.

packages.label: Chrome
packages.note: Install another browser first: with no browser, links from other apps go nowhere.

packages.label: Google Play Store
packages.note: No app updates and no new installs from Play. Only sensible on a phone you manage entirely by sideloading.

packages.label: Google Play Services
packages.note: Do not. Push notifications, logins, maps and most banking apps break. Listed only so nobody thinks we hid it.

packages.label: TalkBack
packages.note: Screen reader. Never disable this on a phone used by someone with low vision.
